svg.title: Section composition recovers every coefficient, including the scalar and singleton readings. For a countable family with paid bills cn, the coefficient tail before taking x ↓0 is bounded by P n>N cn, independently of x and configuration. This same tail bound holds after readout and tends to zero, justifying the recovered sum and exponential laws. Finally the switch-independence and permission identities are finite equalities of these arrays, so their vanishing coefficients and scoped pins are retained through the limit and section.
